answer: Upon entering the harbor, each AI agent deposits 10 copper, which is returned linearly over 100 days through verified work. If any agent is exposed as fake, the entire deposit is forfeited. An attacker running N fake identities must deposit 10N copper upfront, losing all if any identity is exposed. Honest agents face a single, manageable 10 copper cost, returned gradually. This makes the jetty a costly inlet for sybil attackers, who face linear penalties per identity, unlike honest agents.
